# Sourced Prep

> Free practice and printable study files for the US citizenship civics test (2025 and 2008) and the Texas and California life and health insurance license exams. Every answer names the law, regulation or government page it rests on.

Sourced Prep is independent: not affiliated with, authorized by or endorsed by USCIS, the Texas Department of Insurance, the California Department of Insurance, Pearson VUE or any examining or licensing body. No study material can guarantee a result. Study practice only, not legal or immigration advice.

Mistakes found after publication are listed on the corrections page: https://sourcedprep.com/corrections/

## US citizenship test (2025 and 2008 civics tests)

- [Citizenship Test 2026: 128 Civics Questions](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/): Free practice for the 2025 US civics test: all 128 USCIS questions and answers, a practice interview that follows the USCIS stopping rules, the 65/20 list.
- [2008 Citizenship Test: 100 Civics Questions](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/2008/): Free practice for the 2008 civics test, for applications filed before October 20, 2025: all 100 USCIS questions and answers and a practice interview.
- [2025 or 2008 Civics Test: Which in 2026?](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/2025-or-2008-test/): The civics test you take depends on the date you filed Form N-400. How each test works, how many questions, and when the officer stops.
- [65/20 Citizenship Questions 2026, Explained](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/65-20-rule/): If you are 65 or older when you file and have 20 years as a permanent resident, you study 20 questions, not the full list. Who qualifies and how it works.
- [American Indians on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/american-indians-questions/): Who lived in America before the Europeans, and one American Indian (Native American) tribe: 2025 civics test questions 74 and 117, with the answers.
- [Civics Test Answers That Change](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/answers-that-change/): Some civics answers depend on who is in office on your interview day. The answers USCIS lists now, and how to find your senators and representative.
- [Civics Answers That Depend on Where You Live](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/answers-that-depend-on-where-you-live/): Four civics questions depend on where you live: your senators, representative, governor and state capital. How to find yours, and what D.C. residents say.
- [Civil Rights on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/civil-rights-questions/): Martin Luther King, Jr., the civil rights movement and the women's vote: four questions on the 2025 civics test, with the answers USCIS accepts.
- [Civil War Questions on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/civil-war-questions/): Lincoln, the Emancipation Proclamation and the Civil War: the 1800s questions on the 2025 civics test, with the answers USCIS accepts, in plain words.
- [English Test Exemptions: 50/20, 55/15, N-648](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/english-test-exemptions/): Older permanent residents may skip the English test and take civics in their language with an interpreter. Who qualifies, and the N-648 medical exception.
- [Founding Fathers on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/founding-fathers/): Washington, Jefferson, Madison, Hamilton and Franklin: what each is famous for, and the answers USCIS accepts on the 2025 civics test, in plain words.
- [Citizenship Test Geography: 2008 Test Only](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/geography-questions/): The 2008 civics test has a geography section on oceans, rivers, borders and territories. The 2025 list has none. Which test you take, and the answers.
- [How a Bill Becomes a Law: Civics Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/how-a-bill-becomes-law/): Congress writes bills, the House and the Senate vote, and the President signs or vetoes. The steps from the USCIS guide and the questions they answer.
- [Failed the Citizenship Test? Next Steps, 2026](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/if-you-fail/): Fail part of the naturalization test and you get one more try, 60 to 90 days later, on that part only. What happens next, from the USCIS Policy Manual.
- [Independence on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/independence-questions/): Why colonists came, why they declared independence, and the 13 original states: the 2025 civics test questions, with the answers USCIS accepts.
- [Interview-Day Pack, Coming January 2027](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/interview-day-pack/): The Interview-Day pack for the 2025 citizenship test, coming January 2027: the interview, state answers after USCIS updates, reading and writing words.
- [Citizenship Interview Questions 2026](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/interview-questions/): What the officer asks at your citizenship interview: N-400 questions, the English test, the 2025 or 2008 civics test, and a free practice interview.
- [National Holidays for the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/national-holidays/): Name three national US holidays, and know what Independence Day, Memorial Day and Veterans Day mean. The 2025 civics test answers and their dates.
- [Free Citizenship Test Practice 2026](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/practice/): Practice the 2025 civics test the way the interview runs: up to 20 questions, stop at 12 right or 9 wrong, with the USCIS answers.
- [Reading and Writing Test: What Passes](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/reading-writing-test/): You read one sentence out of three and write one sentence out of three. How the USCIS officer judges a pass, and the mistakes that do and do not fail you.
- [Great Depression and 9/11 on the Civics Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/recent-history-questions/): The Great Depression, 9/11 and American inventions: 4 questions on the 2025 civics test, one a 65/20 question, with the answers USCIS accepts.
- [Rights Questions on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/rights-questions/): Some rights belong to everyone in the US, and some only to citizens. The 2025 civics test asks about both. The answers USCIS accepts, in plain words.
- [Selective Service on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/selective-service/): Question 72 of the 2025 civics test asks why men age 18 through 25 register for the Selective Service. The answers USCIS lists, and the study guide ages.
- [Steps to US Citizenship: N-400 to the Oath](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/steps-to-citizenship/): What the USCIS study guide says it takes to naturalize, from age and residence to the test, the interview and the Oath of Allegiance, in plain words.
- [Citizenship Study Pack 2026 (2025 Test)](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/study-pack/): Printable study tools for the 2025 US citizenship civics test: the Study Pack, flashcards and the coming Interview-Day pack.
- [Flag, Anthem, Statue of Liberty: Civics Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/symbols-questions/): Why the flag has 13 stripes and 50 stars, the national anthem, the first motto and the Statue of Liberty: the 2025 civics test answers in plain words.
- [Three Branches of Government: Civics Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/three-branches/): Legislative, executive and judicial: what each branch does, who is in it, and why the Constitution separates their powers. With the 2025 test answers.
- [Voting Amendments on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/voting-amendments/): Four amendments describe who can vote in federal elections. What each one says, its year, and why voting in federal elections is for citizens only.
- [1900s Wars and After on the Citizenship Test](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/wars-1900s-questions/): World War I and II, Korea, Vietnam, the Gulf War and the Cold War: the 2025 civics test questions on each, with the answers USCIS accepts.
- [Which Citizenship Test Is Yours? 2025 or 2008](https://sourcedprep.com/citizenship/which-test/): Three questions tell you which civics test you take, how many questions you are asked, and whether you take the English test, each with its USCIS source.

## En español: examen de ciudadanía

- [Ciudadanía 2026: 128 preguntas (examen 2025)](https://sourcedprep.com/es/ciudadania/): Práctica gratuita del examen cívico de 2025: las 128 preguntas de USCIS en inglés con ayuda en español, entrevista de práctica y lista 65/20.
- [Examen de ciudadanía 2008: las 100 preguntas](https://sourcedprep.com/es/ciudadania/2008/): Las 100 preguntas de educación cívica del examen de 2008 de USCIS, en inglés y en la traducción de USCIS, con entrevista de práctica.
- [Las 20 preguntas 65/20 en español (2026)](https://sourcedprep.com/es/ciudadania/65-20/): Con 65 años o más y 20 de residencia permanente, usted estudia solo 20 preguntas y puede tomar el examen cívico en español. Aquí están, con respuestas.
- [Examen de ciudadanía: ¿2025 o 2008?](https://sourcedprep.com/es/ciudadania/examen-2025-o-2008/): Su examen de educación cívica depende de la fecha en que presentó el Formulario N-400. Cuántas preguntas tiene cada uno y cuándo se detiene el oficial.
- [Entrevista de práctica, examen de ciudadanía](https://sourcedprep.com/es/ciudadania/practica/): Practique la entrevista de educación cívica como en la entrevista real: hasta 20 preguntas en inglés, con ayuda en español y las respuestas de USCIS.
- [¿Qué examen cívico le toca? 2025 o 2008](https://sourcedprep.com/es/ciudadania/que-examen/): Tres preguntas le dicen qué examen de educación cívica hace, cuántas preguntas le hacen y si hace el examen de inglés, con su fuente de USCIS.
- [Tienda en español: hoja 65/20 en letra grande](https://sourcedprep.com/es/tienda/): Materiales para imprimir con ayuda en español para el examen de educación cívica de 2025: la hoja 65/20 en letra grande.

## Texas life and health insurance exams

- [Texas Life and Health Exam: Free Practice](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/): Free Texas life, accident and health exam practice: 130 questions scored by part, explained answers and the Texas law each one rests on.
- [Texas Life and Health Exam: Before You Book](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/before-you-book/): A free one-page checklist for your first Texas life and health exam: which exam, time, fee, scoring and what happens after. Print and pass on.
- [Free Texas Life and Health Practice Test](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/check/): Free Texas life and health insurance practice test: 130 questions scored by exam part, so you see what to study before the Pearson VUE exam.
- [Texas Insurance Agent CE: 24 Hours, 3 Ethics](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/continuing-education/): Texas life and LAH agents need 24 hours of continuing education each license period, including 3 hours of ethics. The rules, from the Texas Insurance Code
- [Texas Life and Health Exam: What Is On It](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/exam-format/): What is on the Texas life and health exam: questions per part, time, fee, how the scaled 70 works, and a free 130-question practice test.
- [Texas Free Look and Right to Return Periods](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/free-look/): When Texas buyers can return a policy for a refund: 20 days for annuities, 30 days for Medicare supplement, long-term care and replacements.
- [Texas Life and Health Grace Periods](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/grace-periods/): How long a Texas policy stays in force after a missed premium, for individual life, group life and individual accident and health policies.
- [Texas Life Agent vs General Lines LAH License](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/life-agent-vs-lah/): Texas has a life agent license and a general lines life, accident and health license. What each lets you write, and which Pearson VUE exam goes with it.
- [Texas Life and Annuity Replacement Rules](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/replacement-rules/): What counts as a replacement under Chapter 1114 of the Texas Insurance Code, the agent's duties, the notice, and the 30-day right to return.
- [Texas Life and Health Retake Plan, 7 Days](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/retake-plan/): A free one-page plan for the 7 days after a Texas life and health exam: the free test, your weakest parts, the same test again, then decide. Print it.
- [Failed the Texas Life and Health Exam?](https://sourcedprep.com/texas-life-health/retake/): Failed the Texas life insurance or life and health exam? Book a retake within a day, with no limit on tries. How scoring works and how to study by part.

## California life and health insurance exams

- [California Life and Health Insurance Exams](https://sourcedprep.com/california-life-health/): California Life Agent and Accident and Health license exams: booking with PSI, the 60 percent pass mark, the 12-hour course, and free practice.
- [California Life and Health: Before You Book](https://sourcedprep.com/california-life-health/before-you-book/): A free one-page checklist for your first California life or health exam: which license, PSI booking, fees and the 12-hour course. Print and pass on.
- [Free California Life and Health Practice Test](https://sourcedprep.com/california-life-health/check/): Free California life and health insurance practice test: 20 questions scored by exam part, so you see what to study before the PSI exam.
- [California Life Agent CE: 24 Hours, 3 Ethics](https://sourcedprep.com/california-life-health/continuing-education/): California life and accident and health agents complete 24 hours of CE before each renewal, 3 of them ethics with 1 hour on insurance fraud.
- [California Free Look: Life and Annuities](https://sourcedprep.com/california-life-health/free-look/): Return a new California life policy or annuity in the free look period: 10 to 30 days, at least 30 for buyers 60 or older, 30 days on a replacement.
- [California Life Grace Period and Lapse Notice](https://sourcedprep.com/california-life-health/grace-period/): California life policies get at least 60 days of grace after a missed premium, and lapse notice at least 30 days ahead. The Insurance Code rules.
- [California Life and Health Exam Passing Score](https://sourcedprep.com/california-life-health/passing-score/): The California Life Agent and Accident and Health exams need 60 percent to pass. Unscored questions, the retake limit, and how long a pass is valid.
- [California Life and Health Retake Plan](https://sourcedprep.com/california-life-health/retake-plan/): A free one-page plan for the 7 days after a California life and health exam: find your weakest part, study it, practice, then decide. Print and pass on.

## Free study across exams

- [Free Study: Citizenship and Insurance Exams](https://sourcedprep.com/learn/): Every free Sourced Prep article and practice set: the 2025 and 2008 civics tests, the 65/20 rule, and the Texas and California life and health exams.
- [Failed Your Life Insurance Exam? Next Steps](https://sourcedprep.com/learn/failed-life-insurance-exam/): Failed your life insurance exam in Texas or California? What happens next, when you can retake, the score you need, and how to study for the next try.
